body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0175 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "Process tampering indicators (Sysmon 25 if present) - Behavior: Process tampering indicators (Sysmon 25 if present). Anchor is process+flag or event id+field after classic/XML coalesce. Not telemetry_validated. Sysmon 25 ProcessTampering"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0175"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1055.012"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINDOWS_SYSMON"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "25"

  condition:
    $e
}
